Description: Role-based login for students faculty and admin
Seat clash prerequisite and credit limit checks
As a user I want to log in with my role so that I only see features meant for me. AC: valid credentials land on role home page; invalid credentials show error and no access.
As a student I want to search and filter courses so that I can find the ones I need quickly. AC: search by code or name lists matches; department filter limits results.
As a student I want to see course details so that I can decide before registering. AC: credits schedule faculty seats left and prerequisites are shown.
As a student I want to register for a course so that it is added to my timetable. AC: open window and valid checks confirm registration; closed window shows registration closed.
As a student I want to join a waitlist when a course is full. AC: full course offers waitlist; freed seat registers first waitlisted student and notifies them.
As a student I want clashes flagged so that I do not register for overlapping classes. AC: overlapping course is blocked and the clashing course is named.

Summary: US-07 Prerequisite and credit limit check
Description: As a student I want prerequisites and credit limits checked. AC: missing prerequisite blocks and names the course; exceeding credit limit blocks and shows the limit.
As a student I want to drop a course so that I can fix a mistake. AC: open drop window releases the seat and confirms; closed window blocks the drop.
As a faculty member I want to see my class list. AC: only currently enrolled students are shown.
As an admin I want to manage courses. AC: created or edited course appears in the catalog; closed course rejects registrations.
As a student I want notifications. AC: register drop and waitlist promotion each trigger a notification.
As an admin I want enrolment reports. AC: export shows enrolled and waitlisted counts for the chosen course or department.
